description.zh: 绕过对 base64 Marshal 串（BAh 开头）的检测：改为十六进制传输再 pack 还原；流内容为真实 ERB gadget 对象流（04 08 版本头与 o: 对象标记，@src 指向反引号命令），Marshal.load 还原 ERB 实例，应用侧对其调用 result 时触发命令执行；判据：还原对象 class 为 ERB 且 @src 为反引号命令，result 渲染回显命令输出。
description.en: Evades detection keyed on base64 Marshal strings (the BAh prefix) by delivering hex and restoring through pack. The stream is a real ERB gadget object (04 08 version header and an o: object marker whose @src holds a backtick command): Marshal.load rebuilds an ERB instance and execution fires when the application calls result on it. Check: restored object is ERB with the backtick command in @src.

explanation.en: object marker and ERB class name (o: + ERB)

description.zh: 以 URL 安全字母表传输 gadget：编码产物不含 +、/ 与填充字符，可原样穿过 URL 参数与查询串，规避标准 base64 特征与斜杠过滤；解码结果为真实 ERB gadget 对象流（04 08 头，@src 指向反引号命令），Marshal.load 还原后应用侧调用 result 触发命令执行；判据：result 渲染回显命令输出。
description.en: Carries the gadget in the URL-safe alphabet so it passes through query strings untouched, dodging standard base64 signatures and slash filtering; the encoded stream has no +, /, or padding characters. Decoding yields a real ERB gadget object (04 08 header, backtick command in @src) rebuilt by Marshal.load; execution fires when the application calls result. Success: command output rendered.

explanation.en: stream header plus object marker (04 08 o)

title.zh: if 反引号变量中转变体

description.zh: 改走 {if} 语句标签的真实混淆面：条件内以反引号执行命令并把输出存入模板变量，正文用 {$t} 输出，全程不出现 system/exec 函数名与 {php} 标签，可同时规避 {php} 黑名单与命令函数特征；本载荷所属 {php} 标签族仅存在于 Smarty <3.1、{php} 标签可用时，{if} 路线在模板安全模式关闭的各版本均可编译。判据：页面回显 id 输出。
description.en: Moves to the real if-tag surface: a backtick runs inside the condition and stores its output in a template variable that the body prints, so neither a system/exec call name nor the php tag ever appears. The php-tag family this payload belongs to exists only on Smarty below 3.1 while the php tag is available; the if-tag route itself compiles wherever template security is off. Success: id output rendered.

explanation.zh: 反引号执行并存入变量
explanation.en: Backtick execution stored into a variable
